A crack in a glass aquarium can make a mess, and it doesn't take much to create a crack, especially in older aquariums. I have brooked my tank when was putting there a small decoration rock . I accidentally hit the wall of the tank with the harp side of the rock which I found on the seaside. A small crack appeared on the all side from the bottom to the top. I solved this problem by purchasing a tube of aquarium-safe silicone gel. Many types of silicone have chemicals that are harmful to fish and other marine life. The gel should be clear, and free of any anti-mold additives. I put the silicon on the crack and allow to dry for at least 48 hours before add water. Now my tank looks like new and i put there another reef live rock which I purchased from this site ( arcreef ) it doesn’t have a thought sides and are not heavy at all .
